programme.title: Halloween Wars - Clowns vs. Zombies
programme.desc: Five remaining teams go into battle to create Halloween-themed displays that depict a face-off between clowns and zombies; special guest judge John Kassir, voice of the Crypt Keeper on the TV series "Tales from the Crypt." - Jonathan Bennett, Shinmin Li, Todd Tucker, Shinmin Li (Competition Reality, Cooking, Holiday, Reality, Series)

programme.title: Halloween Wars - Witch Gets a New Ride
programme.desc: Four teams put their skills to the test to create displays that show what happens when a witch trades in her tired old broom for a brand-new ride; writer, director and producer Mick Garris of the film "Hocus Pocus" joins the judges. - Jonathan Bennett, Shinmin Li, Todd Tucker, Shinmin Li (Competition Reality, Cooking, Holiday, Reality, Series)

programme.title: Halloween Wars - Halloween Time Travel
programme.desc: The remaining teams pull out all the stops to create scrumptious Halloween-themed displays that bend time and space to show their vision of Halloween time travel; "Stranger Things" actor Gaten Matarazzo serves as guest judge. - Jonathan Bennett, Shinmin Li, Todd Tucker, Shinmin Li (Competition Reality, Cooking, Holiday, Reality, Series)

programme.title: Buddy's Bakery Rescue - Baked Euphoria
programme.desc: Repairing low morale and fixing the menu. - Buddy Valastro, Buddy Valastro (Cooking, Reality, Series)

programme.title: Yard Crashers - Woodsy Hideaway
programme.desc: Chris delivers a natural stacked stone fire pit, redwood log benches, decomposed granite patio, massive gable style pergola with an outdoor kitchen with BBQ grill, a granite counter prep station and a combination pizza oven/smoker for outdoor lovers. - Chris Lambton, Matt Blashaw (Home improvement, House/garden, How-to, Reality, Series)

programme.title: Yard Crashers - Yard Crashers Visits Blog Cabin In Central Florida
programme.desc: The team heads to "Blog Cabin" to transform the spacious backyard into a place to hang out with lounging benches, a metal fire pit, a large cobblestone patio, and a bocce court. - Matt Blashaw (Home improvement, House/garden, How-to, Reality, Series)

programme.title: Animal Cribs - Rescue Ranch Remodel
programme.desc: A rescue organization needs to stimulate its 200 animals which include sheep, cows, pigs, horses, a llama and an emu, so Antonio designs a stunning build to get the residents active and moving. - Antonio Ballatore (Animals, Home improvement, Reality, Series)

programme.title: Baby Looney Tunes
programme.desc: Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Sylvester, Lola, Tweety and Taz all live together as toddlers! The series takes a trip back to when the characters were all preschool age and living with Granny in a big mansion. Learning new things together, Bugs often leads the bunch using their imaginations and learning life lessons under Granny's watchful eye. - Sam Vincent, Janyse Jaud, Ian James Corlett, Sam Vincent, Janyse Jaud (Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy, Kids)

programme.title: Baby Looney Tunes - The Yolk's on You; Baby Gate
programme.desc: Daffy and Melissa team up to play practical jokes on the others; Bugs goes undercover to find out the truth behind Melissa's stories. - Sam Vincent, Janyse Jaud, Ian James Corlett, Sam Vincent, Janyse Jaud (Animated, Animation, Children, Comedy, Kids)

programme.title: Bubble's Hotel - Not a Clue

programme.title: Bubble's Hotel - Dino Might
programme.desc: Bubble tries to help Dash teach the baby dinosaurs how to follow the rules. - Tamara Freeman (Adventure, Animated, Children, Series)

programme.title: Bubble's Hotel - Lost in a Book

programme.title: Bubble's Hotel - The Queen's Day Off

programme.title: MLB Central (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown." (Baseball)

programme.title: MLB Now (Live)
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls. (Baseball)

He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media. (Baseball)

Sent to a government asylum along with her now-blind husband (Mark Ruffalo), she sees conditions deteriorate until civilization itself is in jeopardy, prompting her break-out of the asylum to lead a small group to freedom. - Julianne Moore, Mark Ruffalo, Alice Braga, Yusuke Iseya, Yoshino Kimura (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: The Ruins
programme.desc: Amy (Jena Malone), Stacy (Laura Ramsey), Jeff (Jonathan Tucker) and Eric (Shawn Ashmore) look for fun during a sunny holiday in Mexico, but they get much more than that after visiting an archaeological dig in the jungle. Carnivorous vines try to ensnare the friends in their tendrils, forcing the group to fight for survival. - Jonathan Tucker, Jena Malone, Laura Ramsey, Shawn Ashmore, Joe Anderson (Horror, Thriller, Adventure, Action, Mystery)

programme.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: The Cradle of Life
programme.desc: Fearless explorer Lara Croft (Angelina Jolie) tries to locate Pandora's box before criminals Jonathan Reiss (Ciarán Hinds) and Chen Lo (Simon Yam) use it for evil. According to myth, the box holds deadly organisms that could kill millions of people. With her old partner, Terry (Gerard Butler), Croft goes on a hunt that takes her from Europe to Asia to Africa, where pal Kosa (Djimon Hounsou) helps her. Along the way, Croft rappels down cliffs, scuba dives and decimates many male opponents. - Angelina Jolie, Gerard Butler, Ciarán Hinds, Christopher Barrie, Noah Taylor (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: The Haunting
programme.desc: This horror tale focuses on visitors to the secluded mansion of Hill House who have been called to the isolated location by Dr. David Marrow (Liam Neeson) as part of a study on insomnia. However, Marrow is really investigating fear, and he plans to scare the subjects, including the introverted Nell (Lili Taylor) and the seductive Theo (Catherine Zeta-Jones). Unfortunately for Marrow and everyone staying at Hill House, the manor is actually haunted by an evil spirit out to torment its guests. - Liam Neeson, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Owen Wilson, Lili Taylor, Bruce Dern (Horror, Thriller, Fantasy, Mystery)

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: It sounds like just another urban legend -- a videotape filled with nightmarish images leads to a phone call foretelling the viewer's death in exactly seven days. Newspaper reporter Rachel Keller (Naomi Watts) is skeptical of the story until four teenagers all die mysteriously exactly one week after watching just such a tape. Allowing her investigative curiosity to get the better of her, Rachel tracks down the video and watches it. Now she has just seven days to unravel the mystery. - Naomi Watts, Martin Henderson, David Dorfman, Brian Cox, Jane Alexander (Horror, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 2
programme.desc: When the Reys move into their new Southern California home, little do they realize that the house is already occupied. After coming home one day to find the house in disarray -- but with no signs of forced entry or robbery -- they install a video surveillance system to catch the perpetrators. But nothing prepares them for what happens next. - Katie Featherston, Micah Sloat, Brian Boland, Molly Ephraim, Sprague Grayden (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe. - Jessica Chastain, Idris Elba, Michael Cera, Kevin Costner, Jeremy Strong (Biography, Drama)

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: In the tiny town of Brixton, Georgia where nothing is private, a woman with supernatural clairvoyance, a young beautiful socialite who has mysteriously disappeared, and an assortment of colorful characters all collide. A haunting psychological thriller, "The Gift" is ultimately a profound celebration of the human spirit. - Cate Blanchett, Giovanni Ribisi, Keanu Reeves, Katie Holmes, Greg Kinnear (Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: You're Dating a Narcissist!

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
programme.desc: At the start of the New Year, 32-year-old Bridget (Renée Zellweger) decides it's time to take control of her life -- and start keeping a diary. Now, the most provocative, erotic and hysterical book on her bedside table is the one she's writing. With a taste for adventure, and an opinion on every subject - from exercise to men to food to sex and everything in between - she's turning the page on a whole new life. - Renée Zellweger, Colin Firth, Hugh Grant, Gemma Jones, Jim Broadbent (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
programme.desc: The sequel to "Bridget Jones's Diary" finds Bridget (Renée Zellweger) working as a TV host and still dating barrister Mark (Colin Firth). But Bridget is jealous of the time Mark spends with a co-worker (Jacinda Barrett), and, despite a vacation meant to smooth things over, ends their relationship. On assignment in Thailand, she has a dalliance with her disreputable ex, Daniel (Hugh Grant), and is temporarily jailed on the false accusation of drug smuggling, before Mark comes to the rescue. - Renée Zellweger, Hugh Grant, Colin Firth, Jim Broadbent, Gemma Jones (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Starting a new job can be a difficult challenge, especially if you're already retired. Looking to get back into the game, 70-year-old widower Ben Whittaker seizes the opportunity to become a senior intern at an online fashion site. Ben soon becomes popular with his younger co-workers, including Jules Ostin, the boss and founder of the company. Whittaker's charm, wisdom and sense of humor help him develop a special bond and growing friendship with Jules. - Robert De Niro, Anne Hathaway, Rene Russo, Anders Holm, JoJo Kushner (Comedy drama)

programme.title: What Women Want

programme.title: Magic Mike
programme.desc: By day, Mike (Channing Tatum) makes ends meet any way he can -- handyman jobs, detailing cars or designing furniture. But nighttime is when Mike really gets to display his many talents: He's the hot headliner in an all-male revue. Mike sees potential in a 19-year-old he dubs the Kid (Alex Pettyfer), takes the teen under his wing and instructs him in the tricks of the trade. However, Mike learns there's a downside to the stripper lifestyle when it threatens his romance with the Kid's sister. - Channing Tatum, Alex Pettyfer, Matthew McConaughey, Cody Horn, Olivia Munn (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Magic Mike XXL
programme.desc: It's been three years since Mike Lane's (Channing Tatum) retirement from stripping, but the former dancer misses the excitement and feeling of being on stage. Most of all, though, he misses the best friends that he ever had, the crew known as the Kings of Tampa. Opportunity comes knocking when the guys look him up as they travel to Myrtle Beach, S.C., for a stripper convention. With the promise of outrageous fun, a reinvigorated Mike can't resist the chance to join in and take it off again. - Channing Tatum, Matt Bomer, Joe Manganiello, Kevin Nash, Adam Rodriguez (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Regarding Henry
programme.desc: An unscrupulous corporate lawyer, Henry Turner (Harrison Ford) will do whatever it takes to win a case, and treats his family with the same degree of ruthlessness. After Henry gets caught in the middle of a robbery and is shot in the head, he wakes from a coma to find that he has amnesia and can't even remember how to do the simplest of tasks. As he recovers and relearns how to function, Henry reveals a much kinder and more thoughtful personality, much to the surprise of his family and friends. - Harrison Ford, Annette Bening, Bill Nunn, Mikki Allen, Donald Moffat (Drama)

programme.title: View From the Top

The road to success, though, is rarely a smooth flight, and as she begins her trip she encounters more turbulence than even she bargained for. - Gwyneth Paltrow, Christina Applegate, Mark Ruffalo, Candice Bergen, Joshua Malina (Comedy, Romance, Drama)

programme.title: Furlough

Monica is ferociously competitive but sometimes becomes overly emotional on the court. Over the years, the two begin to fall for each other, but their separate paths to basketball stardom threaten to pull them apart. - Sanaa Lathan, Omar Epps, Alfre Woodard, Dennis Haysbert, Debbi Morgan (Romance, Drama)

Simmons (Comedy drama, Adventure, Romance)

programme.title: Hannah Montana - B-B-B-Bad to the Chrome
programme.desc: S3E22 - Miley, Jackson and Robby trade in Mamaw's car for a newer one. - Miley Cyrus, Billy Ray Cyrus, Emily Osment, Jason Earles, Mitchel Musso (Children, Sitcom)

programme.title: Hannah Montana - Judge Me Tender
programme.desc: S3E24 - Hannah fills in as a guest judge on "America's Top Talent"; Robby makes Jackson clean the attic as punishment for receiving a traffic ticket. - Miley Cyrus, Billy Ray Cyrus, Emily Osment, Jason Earles, Mitchel Musso (Children, Sitcom)

programme.title: Hannah Montana - Can't Get Home to You, Girl
programme.desc: S3E25 - Miley's flight gets canceled, and she struggles to make it home in time for Lilly's birthday. - Miley Cyrus, Billy Ray Cyrus, Emily Osment, Jason Earles, Mitchel Musso (Children, Sitcom)

programme.title: Hannah Montana - Come Fail Away
programme.desc: S3E26 - Miley works with a voice actor to win a role; Rico tries to make his restaurant upscale. - Miley Cyrus, Billy Ray Cyrus, Emily Osment, Jason Earles, Mitchel Musso (Children, Sitcom)

programme.title: Hannah Montana - Got to Get Her Out of My House
programme.desc: S3E27 - When Miley accidentally gets Lilly fired, Lilly becomes the Stewarts' housekeeper. - Miley Cyrus, Billy Ray Cyrus, Emily Osment, Jason Earles, Mitchel Musso (Children, Sitcom)

programme.title: Hannah Montana - The Wheel Near My Bed (Keeps on Turnin')
programme.desc: S3E28 - Miley offers to share her room with Lilly, but being roommates quickly takes a toll on the girls' friendship. - Miley Cyrus, Billy Ray Cyrus, Emily Osment, Jason Earles, Mitchel Musso (Children, Sitcom)

programme.title: Hannah Montana - Miley Says Goodbye?
programme.desc: S3E29 - Everyone has important decisions to make about their futures. - Miley Cyrus, Billy Ray Cyrus, Emily Osment, Jason Earles, Mitchel Musso (Children, Sitcom)

programme.title: Hannah Montana - Miley Says Goodbye?
programme.desc: S3E30 - In the second part of this season finale, Miley is contemplating the pros and cons of moving home to Tennessee and Oliver has the opportunity to open for a band during their world tour. - Miley Cyrus, Billy Ray Cyrus, Emily Osment, Jason Earles, Mitchel Musso (Children, Sitcom)

programme.title: Hannah Montana - Sweet Home Hannah Montana
programme.desc: S4E1 - The Stewarts move into their new home; Jackson has his eyes on the neighbor's cousin. - Miley Cyrus, Billy Ray Cyrus, Emily Osment, Jason Earles, Moises Arias (Children, Sitcom)

programme.title: Hannah Montana Forever - Hannah Montana to the Principal's Office
programme.desc: S4E2 - Hannah enrolls in Seaview High after a mix-up prevents Miley from attending the school for her senior year. - Miley Cyrus, Billy Ray Cyrus, Emily Osment, Jason Earles, Moises Arias (Children, Sitcom)

programme.title: Hannah Montana Forever - California Screamin'
programme.desc: S4E3 - Miley and Lilly decide it's time for Robby to start dating again, and decide the school nurse would be right for him; Jackson is waiting for his first kiss from Siena. - Miley Cyrus, Billy Ray Cyrus, Emily Osment, Jason Earles, Moises Arias (Children, Sitcom)

programme.title: Hannah Montana Forever - De-Do-Do-Do, Da-Don't-Don't-Don't Tell My Secret!
programme.desc: S4E4 - Siena assumes the worst when Jackson can't explain why ex-girlfriend Hannah Montana is lurking outside his new home. - Miley Cyrus, Billy Ray Cyrus, Emily Osment, Jason Earles, Moises Arias (Children, Sitcom)

programme.title: Hannah Montana Forever - It's the End of the Jake As We Know It
programme.desc: S4E5 - Oliver returns to visit Miley and Lilly, but also reveals to Miley that Jake is two-timing her, just as Miley is scheduled to film a Hannah Holiday Special with Jake and sing a duet with Sheryl Crow. - Miley Cyrus, Billy Ray Cyrus, Emily Osment, Jason Earles, Moises Arias (Children, Sitcom)

programme.title: Hannah Montana Forever - Been Here All Along
programme.desc: S4E6 - Robby Ray is planning a special father and daughter afternoon with Mile, but Miley cancels it to go on a date with Jesse. - Miley Cyrus, Billy Ray Cyrus, Emily Osment, Jason Earles, Moises Arias (Children, Sitcom)

programme.title: Hannah Montana Forever - Love That Lets Go
programme.desc: S4E7 - Lilly finally works up the nerve to ride Blue Jeans, and while doing so, a snake bites him, making him ill. - Miley Cyrus, Emily Osment, Jason Earles, Moises Arias, Billy Ray Cyrus (Children, Sitcom)

programme.title: Hannah Montana Forever - Hannah's Gonna Get This
programme.desc: S4E8 - Hannah's producer tells her she's got to write a bonus track for her album, but she has writer's block. What she eventually writes is very different from Hannah's normal material. - Miley Cyrus, Billy Ray Cyrus, Emily Osment, Jason Earles, Moises Arias (Children, Sitcom)

programme.title: Hannah Montana Forever - Can You See The Real Me
programme.desc: S4E10 - After Miley finally reveals the truth to the world about her other identity as pop superstar Hannah Montana, she's interviewed by Robin Roberts on Good Morning America. - Miley Cyrus, Billy Ray Cyrus, Emily Osment, Jason Earles, Moises Arias (Children, Sitcom)

programme.title: Hannah Montana Forever - Kiss It All Goodbye
programme.desc: S4E11 - Miley finds that the critics and parents don't like her after she revealed she was Hannah Montana. - Miley Cyrus, Billy Ray Cyrus, Emily Osment, Jason Earles, Moises Arias (Children, Sitcom)

programme.title: Hannah Montana Forever - I Am Mamaw, Hear Me Roar!
programme.desc: S4E12 - When graduation day arrives, Mamaw can't even get a picture; Jackson tells Sienna he wouldn't like her with short hair. - Miley Cyrus, Billy Ray Cyrus, Emily Osment, Jason Earles, Moises Arias (Children, Sitcom)

programme.title: Hannah Montana - Lilly, Do You Want to Know a Secret?
programme.desc: S1E1 - Lilly invites Miley to a Hannah Montana concert; Jackson needs money for a date. - Miley Cyrus, Billy Ray Cyrus, Emily Osment, Jason Earles, Mitchel Musso (Children, Sitcom)

programme.title: Chibiverse - Pizza vs. Fireworks
programme.desc: S1E1 - Molly McGee and Tilly Green bring adventures from all across the Chibiverse; Scratch and Cricket Green argue over whether to end their show with a pizza party or with fireworks. (Animated, Children, Adventure)

programme.title: Bakugan - Viva Corndogs; Hard Water
programme.desc: S1E6 - When Dan goes viral as the butt of a joke, Drago tries to keep him away from social media, while their other friends try to take the video down. (Anime, Children, Action, Adventure, Fantasy)

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! GO RUSH!! - Welcome Home, Yudias (New)

programme.title: Beyblade X - Annihilation (New)

(Children, Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Beyblade X - Another X (New)

programme.title: Chibiverse - Bad Luck Chibis

programme.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug and Cat Noir - The Dark Castle

programme.title: Blade
programme.desc: A half-mortal, half-immortal is out to avenge his mother's death and rid the world of vampires. The modern-day technologically advanced vampires he is going after are in search of his special blood type needed to summon an evil god who plays a key role in their plan to execute the human race. - Wesley Snipes, Stephen Dorff, Kris Kristofferson, N'Bushe Wright, Donal Logue (Horror, Action)

programme.title: Blade II
programme.desc: Exploding from the pages of Marvel Comics comes the thrilling follow-up to the blockbuster "Blade." Half Man ... half vampire, and consumed by a desire to avenge the curse of his birth and save the human race from a blood-drenched Armageddon. In this newest action-packed adventure, Blade (Wesley Snipes) is forced to team up with the very vampires he hates in order to overcome a new type of monster which threatens to eradicate both races. - Wesley Snipes, Kris Kristofferson, Ron Perlman, Leonor Varela, Norman Reedus (Horror, Action, Fantasy)

programme.title: Blade: Trinity
programme.desc: The war between humans and vampires continues, but the humans' best hope, human-vampire hybrid warrior Blade (Wesley Snipes), has been framed for countless murders, turning popular sentiment against him. The vampire leader responsible for Blade's bad publicity is Danica Talos (Parker Posey), who's determined to finally lead her bloodthirsty compatriots to victory. Now Blade must team up with a band of rogue vampire hunters (Ryan Reynolds, Jessica Biel) to save humanity. - Wesley Snipes, Kris Kristofferson, Jessica Biel, Ryan Reynolds, Parker Posey (Horror, Action, Fantasy, Science fiction)

programme.title: Regarding Henry
programme.desc: An unscrupulous corporate lawyer, Henry Turner (Harrison Ford) will do whatever it takes to win a case, and treats his family with the same degree of ruthlessness. After Henry gets caught in the middle of a robbery and is shot in the head, he wakes from a coma to find that he has amnesia and can't even remember how to do the simplest of tasks. As he recovers and relearns how to function, Henry reveals a much kinder and more thoughtful personality, much to the surprise of his family and friends. - Harrison Ford, Annette Bening, Bill Nunn, Mikki Allen, Donald Moffat (Drama)

programme.desc: Dr. Indiana Jones, a renowned archeologist and expert in the occult, is hired by the U.S. Government to find the ark of the covenant, which is believed to still hold the Ten Commandments. Unfortunately, Hitler's agents are also after the ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion escape from various close scrapes in a quest that takes them from Nepal to Cairo. - Harrison Ford, Karen Allen, Paul Freeman, Wolf Kahler, Ronald Lacey (Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Our Ghosts

programme.title: Three Wishes
programme.desc: When single mother Jeanne Holman turns to avoid hitting a dog with her station wagon, she unwittingly hits bearded drifter Jack McCloud. Against the protests of her scandalized neighbors, Holman insists that the injured man stay at the Holman residence to heal. As the eccentric McCloud recovers from the accident, he becomes a positive influence on -- and an unexpected father figure to -- her young sons, Tom and Gunny. - Patrick Swayze, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio, Joseph Mazzello, Seth Mumy, David Marshall Grant (Fantasy)

programme.title: The Wild Thornberrys Movie
programme.desc: The Wild Thornberrys feature film finds one of America's favorite animated families going on wild adventures around the world. Now, 12-year-old Eliza is in Africa where she meets a mysterious shaman who grants her the power to talk to animals. But there's a catch -- if she reveals her gift she will lose it forever. One day Eliza discovers that poachers plan to kill an elephant herd with an electrified fence and she and Darwin, her pet chimp, must stop them. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy)

programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: The Federation calls on Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) and the crew of the Starship Enterprise to contain an immense nimbused object that's on a crash course with Earth. After investigating, the crew discovers that the alien cloud harbors artificial intelligence with an ominous primary directive. Crisis strikes when a probe dispatched by the energy cloud attacks the crew, abducting navigator Lt. Ilia (Persis Khambatta). An android look-alike containing her memories shows up soon after. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley, Stephen Collins, Persis Khambatta (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Mystery, Thriller)

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: A renegade Vulcan makes Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy), McCoy (DeForest Kelley) and the Enterprise go to a planet at the center of the galaxy. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan, Walter Koenig (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: Star Trek Generations
programme.desc: In the 23rd century, the Starship Enterprise is dispatched to the scene of a giant energy field about to engulf two ships. Capt. Kirk (William Shatner) averts calamity, but is exposed to the field and presumed dead. Years later, the Enterprise's new commander, Capt. Picard (Patrick Stewart), learns that one of the disaster's survivors, Dr. Soran (Malcolm McDowell), plans to enter the field by destroying a neighboring star. Picard now must collaborate with an unlikely ally in order to stop him. - Patrick Stewart, William Shatner, Malcolm McDowell, Jonathan Frakes, Brent Spiner (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: The Real Charlie Chaplin
programme.desc: Combining unheard audio recordings, dramatic reconstructions and personal archives, filmmakers Peter Middleton and James Spinney trace Charlie Chaplin's meteoric rise from the slums of Victorian London to the heights of Hollywood superstardom. - Charlie Carter, Sarah Lawn, Jo Price, Matthew Wolf (Documentary)

programme.title: The House of Mirth
programme.desc: Lily (Gillian Anderson) is a ravishing socialite who quickly discovers the precariousness of her position when her beauty and charm start attracting unwelcome interest and jealousy. She seeks a wealthy husband and, in trying to conform to social expectations, she misses her chance for real love with Lawrence Selden (Eric Stoltz). Her quest for a husband comes to a scandalous end when she is falsely accused of having an affair with a married man and is rejected by society and her friends. - Gillian Anderson, Eric Stoltz, Dan Aykroyd, Eleanor Bron, Terry Kinney (Historical drama)

programme.title: The Wedding Singer
programme.desc: Set in 1985, Adam Sandler plays a nice guy with a broken heart who's stuck in one of the most romantic jobs in the world, a wedding singer. He loses all hope when he is abandoned at the altar by his fiancé. He meets a young woman named Julia, who enlists his help to plan her wedding. Eventually, he falls in love with her and must win her over before she gets married. - Adam Sandler, Drew Barrymore, Christine Taylor, Allen Covert, Matthew Glave (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: The Top Gun Naval Fighter Weapons School is where the best of the best train to refine their elite flying skills. When hotshot fighter pilot Maverick (Tom Cruise) is sent to the school, his reckless attitude and cocky demeanor put him at odds with the other pilots, especially the cool and collected Iceman (Val Kilmer). But Maverick isn't only competing to be the top fighter pilot, he's also fighting for the attention of his beautiful flight instructor, Charlotte Blackwood (Kelly McGillis). - Tom Cruise, Kelly McGillis, Anthony Edwards, Val Kilmer, Tom Skerritt (Action, Adventure, Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Slow-witted Forrest Gump (Tom Hanks) has never thought of himself as disadvantaged, and thanks to his supportive mother (Sally Field), he leads anything but a restricted life. Whether dominating on the gridiron as a college football star, fighting in Vietnam or captaining a shrimp boat, Forrest inspires people with his childlike optimism. But one person Forrest cares about most may be the most difficult to save -- his childhood love, the sweet but troubled Jenny (Robin Wright). - Tom Hanks, Robin Wright, Gary Sinise, Mykelti Williamson, Sally Field (Comedy drama, Romance, Adventure, War, Historical drama)

programme.title: School Ties
programme.desc: When David Greene (Brendan Fraser) receives a football scholarship to a prestigious prep school in the 1950s, he feels pressure to hide the fact that he is Jewish from his classmates and teachers, fearing that they may be anti-Semitic. He quickly becomes the big man on campus thanks to his football skills, but when his Jewish background is discovered, his worst fears are realized and his friends (Matt Damon, Chris O'Donnell) turn on him with violent threats and public ridicule. - Brendan Fraser, Matt Damon, Chris O'Donnell, Randall Batinkoff, Andrew Lowery (Drama)

programme.title: Proof
programme.desc: Catherine (Gwyneth Paltrow) is a 27-year-old grieving after the loss of her father (Anthony Hopkins), a genius mathematician whose mind gradually deteriorated from mental illness. With her sister, Claire (Hope Davis), urging Catherine to leave their family home, and an ambitious student (Jake Gyllenhaal) searching through her father's notes, Catherine struggles to keep her composure and her sanity in this drama adapted from the stage play by David Auburn. - Gwyneth Paltrow, Anthony Hopkins, Jake Gyllenhaal, Hope Davis, Gary Houston (Drama)

When the dislikable Coco gets interested in the single Chaz, Chuckie and his friends swing into action. - Michael Bell (Animated, Children, Adventure, Fantasy)

By coincidence, the adventurous Thornberrys are also exploring the island. So, with his talking dog, Spike (Bruce Willis), in tow, Tommy takes Chuckie on a walkabout meant to find Donnie Thornberry (Flea) and his sister, Eliza (Lacey Chabert). They'll need to be careful, though, as exotic leopard Siri (Chrissie Hynde) is hungry and not afraid to make her presence known. - Michael Bell (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Where the Wild Things Are

They allow Max to become their leader, and he promises to create a kingdom where everyone will be happy. However, Max soon finds that being king is not easy and that, even being with the Wild Things, there is something missing. - Catherine Keener, Max Records, Mark Ruffalo (Children, Fantasy, Adventure)

However, Morticia (Anjelica Huston) begins to suspect the man is a fraud, since he cannot recall details of Fester's life. With the help of lawyer Tully Alford (Dan Hedaya), Fester manages to get the Addams clan evicted from their home. Gomez realizes the two men are conspiring to swindle the Addams fortune and that he must challenge Fester. - Anjelica Huston, Raul Julia, Christopher Lloyd, Dan Hedaya, Elizabeth Wilson (Fantasy, Dark comedy)

programme.title: Galaxy Quest

Believing the cast's heroic on-screen dramas are historical documents of real-life adventures, the band of aliens turns to the ailing celebrities for help in their quest to overcome the oppressive regime in their solar system. - Tim Allen, Sigourney Weaver, Alan Rickman, Tony Shalhoub, Sam Rockwell (Comedy, Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy)

Botched matchmaking leads to some major romantic mix-ups, until an unexpected death in the family helps everyone realize that the most important thing in life is love. - Jack Lemmon, Walter Matthau, Ann-Margret, Sophia Loren, Burgess Meredith (Comedy)

When Kevin meets the girl of his dreams, Abbey, on Chicago's L train, they connect immediately, but he lets this golden opportunity slip away by not having the courage to ask her for her name and number. Unable to find her, or forget her, Kevin and his buddies launch a massive campaign to locate Abbey. - Lance Bass, Joey Fatone, Emmanuelle Chriqui, GQ, James Bulliard (Romantic comedy, Comedy, Romance)

Both students engage in competitive social behavior that affects the student body. - Lindsay Lohan, Rachel McAdams, Tina Fey, Tim Meadows, Amy Poehler (Comedy)

Desperate to revive his fading reputation, Siler agrees to a seemingly impossible challenge. He has six weeks to gain the trust of nerdy outcast Laney Boggs (Rachael Leigh Cook) -- and help her to become the school's next prom queen. - Freddie Prinze Jr., Rachael Leigh Cook, Matthew Lillard, Paul Walker, Jodi Lyn O'Keefe (Romantic comedy, Drama)

Einar holds a grudge against Jean because he feels she's responsible for his son's accidental death, but he reluctantly lets her stay at the farm when he learns that she's trapped in a violent relationship. Over time, they grow closer and try to heal their emotional wounds. - Robert Redford, Morgan Freeman, Jennifer Lopez, Becca Gardner, Josh Lucas (Drama)

Immediately, sparks fly between the two, and marriage is proposed. But Frank isn't the only one with kids to worry about -- Helen has a total of 10. programme.title: Love Me
programme.desc: A buoy and a satellite meet online long after humanity's extinction. As they learn what life was like on Earth, they discover themselves and what it means to be alive and in love. - Kristen Stewart, Steven Yeun (Romance, Science fiction, Drama)

programme.title: Regarding Us
programme.desc: After losing her teaching career in the Catholic school system, a transgender woman has a profound impact on the lives of two children, one with two fathers in marital strife, and the other a recent transplant from a conservative household. When the children form a unique bond, new questions and old prejudices erupt. - Alexandra Grey, David Beck, Jacob Moran, Hudson Paul, Fiona Morgan Quinn (Drama, Comedy)

programme.title: The Wedding Banquet
programme.desc: Hoping to stay in the country, a gay man proposes a green card marriage to a female friend in exchange for paying for her IVF treatment. However, things soon get complicated when his grandmother surprises them with plans for an extravagant Korean wedding banquet. - Bowen Yang, Lily Gladstone, Kelly Marie Tran, Han Gi-chan, Bobo Le (Romantic comedy, LGBTQ)

programme.title: Kevin Garnett: Anything Is Possible
programme.desc: Chronicling the career of one of the NBA's all-time greats, featuring scenes from Garnett's induction into the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame. (Special, Documentary, Basketball)

programme.title: Dean
programme.desc: An illustrator falls in love with a woman while trying to keep his father from burning down the family home after his wife dies. - Demetri Martin, Kevin Kline, Gillian Jacobs, Rory Scovel, Christine Woods (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Just Another Immigrant: Romesh at the Greek
programme.desc: Romesh Ranganathan, a successful comedian in England, moves his entire family to Los Angeles to make it as a comedian in America; he then takes the drastic step of performing his first ever U.S. stand-up show at the historic Greek Theatre. (Special, Comedy, Standup)

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: Gertrude Bell's life as an explorer, cartographer, and archaeologist for the British Empire. - Nicole Kidman, James Franco, Robert Pattinson, Damian Lewis, Jenny Agutter (Biography, Historical drama)

programme.title: I, Daniel Blake
programme.desc: Daniel Blake (Dave Johns) is a 59-year-old widowed carpenter who must rely on welfare after a recent heart attack leaves him unable to work. Despite his doctor's diagnosis, British authorities deny Blake's benefits and tell him to return to his job. As Daniel navigates his way through an agonizing appeal process, he begins to develop a strong bond with a destitute, single mother (Hayley Squires) who's struggling to take care of her two children. - Dave Johns, Hayley Squires, Dylan McKiernan, Briana Shann, Kate Rutter (Drama)

programme.title: Wakefield
programme.desc: Howard Wakefield, a New York City lawyer, hides out in the attic of his home for weeks, coming out in the daytime when his family is gone to shower and eat. His withdrawal leads him to examine his life, and he rationalizes that he has not abandoned his family because he is still in the house. When a former boyfriend re-enters his wife's life, he realizes that he may not be able to return to life he has abandoned. - Bryan Cranston, Jennifer Garner, Jason O'Mara, Beverly D'Angelo, Ian Anthony Dale (Drama)

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Small-time pot dealer David learns the hard way that no good deed goes unpunished; trying to help some teens, he is jumped by thugs and loses his cash and stash. Now, David's in big debt to his supplier and to wipe the slate clean, he must go to Mexico to pick up the guy's latest shipment. To accomplish his mission, Dave devises a foolproof plan: He packs a fake family into a huge RV and heads south of the border for a wild weekend that is sure to end with a bang. - Jennifer Aniston, Jason Sudeikis, Will Poulter, Emma Roberts, Ed Helms (Comedy, Action, Crime drama)

programme.title: Black Lotus
programme.desc: A soldier uses his military training to rescue the kidnapped daughter of his dead friend. - Rico Verhoeven, Frank Grillo, Roland Møller, Rona-Lee Shim'on, Kevin Janssens (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: They
programme.desc: Julia (Laura Regan), a smart, athletic psychology student is finally starting to get her life together. As a kid she was traumatized by night terrors, but now she is cruising towards a successful career as a psychologist and has a rock solid EMT boyfriend to boot (Marc Blucas). After a friend commits suicide - saying the night terrors have returned - Julia and some of her other friends start to experience the same terrors... - Laura Regan, Marc Blucas, Ethan Embry, Dagmara Dominczyk, Jon Abrahams (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Scream 4
programme.desc: It has been many years since the Ghostface Killer cut a deadly path through the town of Woodsboro. In order to get over the trauma of those horrific events, Sidney Prescott (Neve Campbell) has written a self-help book. She returns to Woodsboro for her book tour, and reconnects with old friends Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) and Sheriff Dewey (David Arquette). However, Sidney's arrival also sparks the return of Ghostface, putting Sidney and everyone she loves in danger. - Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox, David Arquette, Emma Roberts, Mary McDonnell (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: Rush Hour
programme.desc: When a Chinese diplomat's daughter is kidnapped in Los Angeles, he calls in Hong Kong Detective Inspector Lee (Jackie Chan) to assist the FBI with the case. But the FBI doesn't want anything to do with Lee, and they dump him off on the LAPD, who assign wisecracking Detective James Carter (Chris Tucker) to watch over him. Although Lee and Carter can't stand each other, they choose to work together to solve the case on their own when they figure out they've been ditched by both the FBI and police. - Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker, Tom Wilkinson, Tzi Ma, Ken Leung (Action, Comedy, Martial arts)

programme.title: Rush Hour 2
programme.desc: After an explosion at the US Embassy in Hong Kong kills two customs agents investigating currency smuggling, Inspector Lee (Jackie Chan) and James Carter (Chris Tucker) search for the mastermind. Ricky Tan (John Lone), head of the Fu-Cang-Long Triad, sends out his minions to ensure that Carter and Lee don't solve the case. - Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker, John Lone, Zhang Ziyi, Roselyn Sánchez (Action, Comedy, Martial arts)

programme.title: Confess, Fletch
programme.desc: While investigating a case of stolen paintings, the roguishly charming and endlessly troublesome Fletch becomes the prime suspect in a murder. To prove his innocence, he must sift through a long list of suspects, including his own girlfriend. - Jon Hamm, Kyle MacLachlan, Marcia Gay Harden, Roy Wood Jr., Annie Mumolo (Comedy, Mystery)

programme.title: Mr. Holmes
programme.desc: Long-retired and near the end of his life, Sherlock Holmes (Ian McKellen) grapples with an unreliable memory and must rely on his housekeeper's son as he revisits the still-unsolved case that led to his retirement. - Ian McKellen, Laura Linney, Milo Parker, Hiroyuki Sanada, Hattie Morahan (Mystery, Drama)

programme.title: Furlough
programme.desc: A young woman works part-time at a prison while also caring for her mother. The rookie guard gets a chance to prove her mettle when she's tasked with accompanying a hell-raising inmate on an emergency furlough to visit her dying mother. But things soon spiral out of control, sending the pair on a surprisingly touching road trip. - Tessa Thompson, Whoopi Goldberg, Melissa Leo, La La Anthony, Drena De Niro (Comedy)

programme.title: The Contractor
programme.desc: Involuntarily discharged from the Army, a special forces sergeant lands a contract with a private underground military force. When his very first assignment goes awry, the elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him. - Chris Pine, Ben Foster, Gillian Jacobs, Eddie Marsan, JD Pardo (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: It sounds like just another urban legend -- a videotape filled with nightmarish images leads to a phone call foretelling the viewer's death in exactly seven days. Newspaper reporter Rachel Keller (Naomi Watts) is skeptical of the story until four teenagers all die mysteriously exactly one week after watching just such a tape. Allowing her investigative curiosity to get the better of her, Rachel tracks down the video and watches it. Now she has just seven days to unravel the mystery. - Naomi Watts, Martin Henderson, David Dorfman, Brian Cox, Jane Alexander (Horror, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Day of the Fight
programme.desc: On the day of his first fight since his release from prison, a former boxing champion reconnects with his trainer, ex-wife, childhood friend, and abusive father in a quest for forgiveness and closure. - Michael C. Pitt, Joe Pesci, Ron Perlman, Steve Buscemi, Nicolette Robinson (Drama)

programme.title: Tales From the Darkside: The Movie
programme.desc: The first of three dark tales involves resentful student Bellingham (Steve Buscemi) looking to an Egyptian mummy for help in settling some scores. Then, hit man Halston (David Johansen) is contracted to kill a cat that has terrorized and even killed members of an extremely wealthy family. Lastly, struggling artist Preston (James Remar) witnesses a demon commit a bizarre murder on a city street, but agrees to keep it a secret when the devilish being promises wealth in return for his silence. - Deborah Harry, Christian Slater, David Johansen, William Hickey, James Remar (Horror)

programme.title: Parasite
programme.desc: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan. - Song Kang-ho, Lee Sun-gyun, Jo Yeo-jeong, Choi Woo-sik, Park So-dam (Dark comedy, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: She's Out of My League
programme.desc: Kirk (Jay Baruchel), an average guy stuck in a dead-end job, can't believe his luck when a gorgeous, successful woman named Molly (Alice Eve) falls in love with him. With no help from his stunned friends, relatives and ex-girlfriend, Kirk must figure out how to make this unlikely relationship work, even though he's the first to admit that Molly is way beyond him. - Jay Baruchel, Alice Eve, T.J. Miller, Mike Vogel, Nate Torrence (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: He's Just Not That Into You
programme.desc: Baltimore-based friends and lovers, all in their 20s and 30s, try to navigate their way through the complexities of modern relationships. Beth (Jennifer Aniston) wants commitment from Neil (Ben Affleck), who sees nothing wrong with the status quo. Gigi (Ginnifer Goodwin) is tired of waiting by the phone, while Mary (Drew Barrymore) has a slew of supportive male friends, none of whom are straight. Meanwhile, Janine has trust issues with her husband, who can't trust himself around Anna. - Ben Affleck, Jennifer Aniston, Drew Barrymore, Jennifer Connelly, Kevin Connolly (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: You're Dating a Narcissist!
programme.desc: A psychology professor who has a knack for spotting narcissists flies across the country to prove that the man her daughter is marrying is a fraud. - Marisa Tomei, Sherry Cola, Ciara Bravo, Marco Pigossi, José María Yazpik (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Scouts Guide to the Zombie Apocalypse
programme.desc: What could possibly go wrong when three buddies (Tye Sheridan, Logan Miller, Joey Morgan) decide to join the Boy Scouts? When bloodthirsty, undead ghouls invade their once-peaceful town, it's up to kindhearted Ben, quick-witted Carter and class clown Augie to save the day. With help from Denise (Sarah Dumont), a beautiful but tough cocktail waitress, the boys must put their scouting skills to the ultimate test to save mankind and earn their zombie-killing badges. - Tye Sheridan, Logan Miller, Joey Morgan, Sarah Dumont, David Koechner (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: Side Effects
programme.desc: For four years, Emily Taylor (Rooney Mara) has awaited the release of her husband, Martin (Channing Tatum), from being imprisoned for insider trading. Finally, Martin comes home, but Emily feels just as bad as she did when he was incarcerated, and she sinks into a deep depression. After her failed suicide attempt, psychiatrist Jonathan Banks (Jude Law) prescribes a series of medications. When those don't work, he gives Emily a new medication -- but the drug leads to ruined lives and death. - Jude Law, Rooney Mara, Channing Tatum, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Vinessa Shaw (Drama, Thriller)

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents Dracula II: Ascension
programme.desc: After a band of medical students receives a decaying but living body reported to be the vampire Count Dracula (Stephen Billington), they set out to harness his power and immortality. As a bonus, their mentor, Lowell (Craig Sheffer), claims that there is a mysterious donor willing to fund their research. During the study, student Elizabeth Blaine (Diane Neal) injures herself on the vampire's tooth and starts to feel strange. Soon, vampire hunter Father Uffizi (Jason Scott Lee) is on their trail. - Jason Scott Lee, Craig Sheffer, Diane Neal, Jason London, Khary Payton (Horror)

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula 2000
programme.desc: Long ago, Abraham Van Helsing (Christopher Plummer) imprisoned the infamous Count Dracula (Gerard Butler) within a vault inside Carfax Abbey. In the present day, Van Helsing relies on Dracula's immortal blood to remain alive. But then thieves break into the vault and steal the vampire's coffin, thinking it contains something valuable. Liberated from his prison, Dracula seizes the opportunity to escape, but Van Helsing sets out to banish him to the crypt once again. - Christopher Plummer, Gerard Butler, Jonny Lee Miller, Justine Waddell, Jennifer Esposito (Horror, Action, Fantasy, Thriller, Romance)

programme.title: Parasite
programme.desc: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan. - Song Kang-ho, Lee Sun-gyun, Jo Yeo-jeong, Choi Woo-sik, Park So-dam (Dark comedy, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: The Death of Stalin
programme.desc: When tyrannical dictator Joseph Stalin dies in 1953, his parasitic cronies square off in a frantic power struggle to become the next Soviet leader. Among the contenders are the dweebish Georgy Malenkov, the wily Nikita Khrushchev and Lavrentiy Beria -- the sadistic secret police chief. As they bumble, brawl and back-stab their way to the top, the question remains -- just who is running the government? - Steve Buscemi, Simon Russell Beale, Jeffrey Tambor, Paddy Considine, Rupert Friend (Dark comedy, Historical drama)

programme.title: The Lovely Bones
programme.desc: After being brutally murdered, 14-year-old Susie Salmon (Saoirse Ronan) watches from heaven over her grief-stricken family (Mark Wahlberg, Rachel Weisz) -- and her killer (Stanley Tucci). As she observes their daily lives, she must balance her thirst for revenge with her desire for her family to heal. - Mark Wahlberg, Rachel Weisz, Susan Sarandon, Stanley Tucci, Michael Imperioli (Drama, Mystery, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Set in 1973, it chronicles the funny and often poignant coming of age of 15-year-old William, an unabashed music fan who is inspired by the seminal bands of the time. When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone Magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe, William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother. - Billy Crudup, Frances McDormand, Kate Hudson, Jason Lee, Patrick Fugit (Comedy drama, Music, Rock, Drama)

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Jim McAllister (Matthew Broderick), a well-liked high school government teacher, can't help but notice that successful student Tracy Flick (Reese Witherspoon) uses less than ethical tactics to get what she wants. When Tracy runs for school president, Jim feels that she will be a poor influence on the student body and convinces Paul, a dim-witted but popular student athlete, to run against Tracy. When she becomes aware of Jim's secret involvement in the race, a bitter feud is sparked. - Matthew Broderick, Reese Witherspoon, Chris Klein, Jessica Campbell, Mark Harelik (Comedy, Drama, Thriller)

programme.title: Memory
programme.desc: Social worker Sylvia's structured life is blown apart when Saul follows her home from their high school reunion. Their surprise encounter profoundly impacts both of them as they open the door to the past. - Jessica Chastain, Peter Sarsgaard, Brooke Timber, Ross Brodar, Josh Charles (Drama)

programme.title: Mimic 3: Sentinel
programme.desc: Marvin (Karl Geary), who is hypersensitive to germs, stays inside taking photos of his neighbors, including a suspicious figure he dubs "The Garbageman" (Lance Henriksen) and a pretty woman named Carmen (Rebecca Mader). He lives with his mother (Amanda Plummer) and sister, Rosy (Alexis Dziena), who spends time with the local drug dealer. When people begin to disappear, Marvin starts playing detective, but he's soon in over his head when a mutant insect species known as the Judas Breed returns. - Karl Geary, Alexis Dziena, Keith Robinson, Rebecca Mader, Amanda Plummer (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Carriers
programme.desc: When a virus threatens to wipe out humanity, Danny (Lou Taylor Pucci), his brother Brian (Chris Pine), and their friends Bobby (Piper Perabo) and Kate (Emily VanCamp) set out across the desert in the Southwest, trying to elude the pandemic. Over the course of several days, the four friends learn that the darkness within themselves may prove deadlier than any microbe. - Lou Taylor Pucci, Chris Pine, Piper Perabo, Emily VanCamp, Christopher Meloni (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Vindicta
programme.desc: When a city is terrorized by a sadistic serial killer, a seasoned detective and a newly recruited paramedic are forced into a deadly game of vengeance, only to discover the key to stopping the bloodshed lies in unlocking the truth of their own pasts. - Elena Kampouris, Jeremy Piven, Sean Astin, Travis Nelson, Bradley Stryker (Thriller)

programme.title: The Autopsy of Jane Doe
programme.desc: When father and son coroners investigate the death of a beautiful "Jane Doe," they find increasingly bizarre clues. - Emile Hirsch, Brian Cox, Ophelia Lovibond, Michael McElhatton, Olwen Kelly (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: The Foreigner
programme.desc: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism. His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers. - Jackie Chan, Pierce Brosnan, Ray Fearon, Orla Brady, Tao Liu (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Red Eye
programme.desc: In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in. She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father. - Rachel McAdams, Cillian Murphy, Brian Cox, Jayma Mays, Jack Scalia (Thriller, Action, Drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Run & Gun
programme.desc: After leaving a life of crime and violence, reformed good guy Ray enjoys a quiet family life in the suburbs. However, Ray's past comes back to haunt him as he gets blackmailed into one last job to collect a mysterious package. After a deadly double-cross, he soon finds himself wounded and on the run from ruthless assassins who will stop at nothing to get what he has. - Ben Milliken, Brad William Henke, Janel Parrish, Mark Dacascos, Celestino Cornielle (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: The Perfect Gamble
programme.desc: Released from prison, two gamblers get entangled with the mafia when they decide to open an illegal casino. - David Arquette, Danny A. Abeckaser, Daniella Pick Tarantino, Dean Miroshnikov, Herzl Tobey (Crime drama)

programme.title: The Last Stop in Yuma County
programme.desc: Stranded at an Arizona rest stop, a traveling knife salesman gets thrust into a high-stakes hostage situation by the arrival of two bank robbers who will stop at nothing to protect their ill-begotten fortune. - Jim Cummings, Jocelin Donahue, Sierra McCormick, Nicholas Logan, Michael Abbott Jr. (Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: You Can Count on Me
programme.desc: Sammy is a single mother who is extremely protective of her 8-year-old son. She is satisfied with living in the small town she grew up in and working in a local bank. When her brother Terry visits he fits the void in the life of both her and her son. Temporarily free of the constraints of single motherhood she begins to break free of her normal routine. In a string of traumatic events Sammy is torn between helping her brother and her maternal instinct to protect her son from getting hurt. - Laura Linney, Mark Ruffalo, Rory Culkin, Matthew Broderick, Jon Tenney (Drama)

programme.title: Brave the Dark
programme.desc: When Mr. Deen discovers one of his students has been living out of his car and thrown into jail, he decides to bail him out. Determined to curb Nate's self-destructive behavior, Mr. Deen discovers a host of secrets that are slowly tearing Nate apart. - Nicholas Hamilton, Jared Harris, Sasha Bhasin, Will Price, Jamie Harris (Drama)

programme.title: South Park: Bigger, Longer & Uncut
programme.desc: In this feature film based on the hit animated series, the third-graders of South Park sneak into an R-rated film by ultra-vulgar Canadian television personalities Terrance (Matt Stone) and Phillip (Trey Parker), and emerge with expanded vocabularies that leave their parents and teachers scandalized. When outraged Americans try to censor the film, the controversy becomes a call to war with Canada, and Terrance and Phillip end up on death row -- with only the kids left to save them. (Animated, Comedy)

programme.title: Old Guy
programme.desc: An aging hit man must train a young prodigy when his employer moves to replace the old guard. However, when they learn they're being betrayed, the unlikely pair turns into a lethal team -- with their double-crossing bosses in their sights. - Christoph Waltz, Lucy Liu, Cooper Hoffman, Ryan McParland, Ann Akinjirin (Action, Comedy)

programme.title: Horrible Bosses
programme.desc: Nick (Jason Bateman), Dale (Charlie Day) and Kurt (Jason Sudeikis) are workers who would like nothing better than to grind their oppressive employers into the dirt. Quitting their jobs is not an option, so -- fueled by alcohol and dubious advice from a criminal (Jamie Foxx) -- the men devise a complex and seemingly foolproof plan to permanently rid themselves of their terrible bosses. The problem is, any plan is only as clever as the brains behind it. - Jason Bateman, Charlie Day, Jason Sudeikis, Jennifer Aniston, Colin Farrell (Comedy)

programme.title: Horrible Bosses 2
programme.desc: Tired of always answering to others, Nick (Jason Bateman), Dale (Charlie Day) and Kurt (Jason Sudeikis) go into business for themselves. After demonstrating the prototype for an invention called the Shower Buddy, the guys attract the attention of Rex Hanson and his father, Bert. Bert invests in the trio's product, then cancels the order and steals their idea. Now heavily in debt and with no legal recourse, Nick, Dale and Kurt decide to kidnap Rex and use the ransom money to pay off their loans. - Jason Bateman, Charlie Day, Jason Sudeikis, Jennifer Aniston, Kevin Spacey (Comedy)

Hidden cameras capture their insane and shocking encounters with a diverse set of unsuspecting citizens, including male strippers, disgruntled contestants (and their mothers) from a children's beauty pageant, mourners at a funeral home, patrons at a biker bar and more. Based on the "Jackass" TV series. - Johnny Knoxville, Jackson Nicoll, Greg Harris, Georgina Cates, Kamber Hejlik (Comedy)

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa 0.5
programme.desc: Irving Zisman takes his young and impressionable grandson on a cross-country trip in which they encounter male strippers, biker-bar patrons and other unsuspecting citizens. - Johnny Knoxville, Jackson Nicoll, Georgina Cates, Greg Harris, Spike Jonze (Comedy)

programme.title: Jackass: Number Two

Danger, pain and bodily fluids are in plentiful supply as the gang tries to up the ante in the continuous quest to shock and annoy. (Comedy, Docudrama)

programme.title: The Mexican

The second is from his girlfriend Samantha to end his association with the mob. Jerry figures alive and in trouble with Samantha is better than the more permanent alternative, so he heads south of the border. - Brad Pitt, Julia Roberts, James Gandolfini, Bob Balaban, J.K. Simmons (Comedy drama, Adventure, Romance)

programme.title: The Foreigner
programme.desc: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism. His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers. - Jackie Chan, Pierce Brosnan, Ray Fearon, Orla Brady, Tao Liu (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: The Firm
programme.desc: A young lawyer joins a small but prestigious law firm only to find out that most of their clients are on the wrong side of the law. The company is helping to launder mob money, get clients off charges and even murder partners who threaten to blow their cover, but when the FBI come calling to gather evidence on the lawyer's colleagues, he is caught between a rock and a hard place, juggling his life and his liberty. - Tom Cruise, Jeanne Tripplehorn, Gene Hackman, Holly Hunter, Ed Harris (Drama, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Blade Runner 2049
programme.desc: Officer K (Ryan Gosling), a new Blade Runner for the Los Angeles Police Department, unearths a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what's left of society into chaos. His discovery leads him on a quest to find Rick Deckard (Harrison Ford), a former Blade Runner who's been missing for 30 years. - Ryan Gosling, Harrison Ford, Ana de Armas, Sylvia Hoeks, Robin Wright (Science fiction, Thriller, Action)

programme.title: John Carpenter's Escape From L.A.
programme.desc: In 2013, the United States president was exiling all citizens who don't conform to his hyper-conservative views to Los Angeles, which became an island after a huge earthquake. But, when the president's daughter nabs the detonator to her dad's apocalyptic weapon and sneaks into L.A. to be with the rebel leader she loves, the government taps commando-turned-crook Snake Plissken to retrieve the young woman. And, if he doesn't succeed quickly, he'll be executed. - Kurt Russell, Stacy Keach, Steve Buscemi, Cliff Robertson, Peter Fonda (Action, Adventure, Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: Doctor Sleep
programme.desc: Struggling with alcoholism, Dan Torrance remains traumatized by the sinister events that occurred at the Overlook Hotel when he was a child. His hope for a peaceful existence soon becomes shattered when he meets Abra, a teen who shares his extrasensory gift of the "shine." Together, they form an unlikely alliance to battle the True Knot, a cult whose members try to feed off the shine of innocents to become immortal. - Ewan McGregor, Rebecca Ferguson, Kyliegh Curran, Cliff Curtis, Zahn McClarnon (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: The Return
programme.desc: After 20 years away, Odysseus washes up on the shores of Ithaca, haggard and unrecognizable. The king finds much has changed since he left to fight in the Trojan War. His beloved wife, Penelope, is a prisoner in her own home and hounded to choose a new husband. Their son faces death at the hands of suitors who see him as an obstacle in their pursuit of Penelope and the kingdom. Odysseus is no longer the mighty warrior his people remember, but he must face his past to save his family. - Ralph Fiennes, Juliette Binoche, Charlie Plummer, Marwan Kenzari, Claudio Santamaria (Adventure, Drama)

In 480 B.C. a state of war exists between Persia, led by King Xerxes (Rodrigo Santoro), and Greece. At the Battle of Thermopylae, Leonidas (Gerard Butler), king of the Greek city state of Sparta, leads his badly outnumbered warriors against the massive Persian army. Though certain death awaits the Spartans, their sacrifice inspires all of Greece to unite against their common enemy. - Gerard Butler, Lena Headey, David Wenham, Dominic West, Rodrigo Santoro (Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, War)

programme.title: 300: Rise of an Empire
programme.desc: Xerxes, driven by vengeance for his father's death, leads an army against Greece; Greek city-states join forces under Athens' command to fight Artemisia in a naval battle. - Sullivan Stapleton, Eva Green, Lena Headey, Hans Matheson, Callan Mulvey (Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, War)

programme.title: Overlord
